3. A UNIT/DEFINITION TRAP: i2 wrote beta_A^kin = d(Delta_RAR^kin)/d(log10 A_eff). The stored regressor is X_A = log10(R_IPR), NOT log10(A_eff). Because R_IPR = sqrt(A_eff/pi), log10 A_eff = 2*log10 R_IPR + log10(pi), so a slope per log10 A_eff is HALF the stored slope per X_A. Cat has NOT applied this factor. See definition_trap below and decide explicitly.
